# Bundled service icons

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs from frontend/src/service-catalog.json. Do not edit. -->

The 341 SVGs in `frontend/public/service-icons/` identify services in the local catalog. They are vendored from the pinned sources below and checked by `scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs` and the frontend test suite: no scripts, event handlers, external references, embedded documents, animation or DTDs (embedded content is limited to base64 raster images), and at most 60 KB each. Navidrome: Decorative rotation removed to keep the artwork static. All other SVGs are unchanged. They are loaded as independent image documents; SVG IDs and styles therefore remain isolated. No icon CDN, external font, script, tracking asset or runtime download is used.

340 icons are from [Dashboard Icons by Homarr Labs and contributors](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/blob/59f1e9a4108f4f510f41e9588f078631de1e1405), distributed under [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/blob/59f1e9a4108f4f510f41e9588f078631de1e1405/LICENSE). The complete license is included as `frontend/public/service-icons/LICENSE.txt`. The upstream distribution has no root NOTICE file. Icons listed with an older commit were vendored earlier and are kept as they were.

The Linkwarden SVG is from [selfh.st Icons by selfh.st and contributors](https://github.com/selfhst/icons/blob/b2378abb1a0c64149bb7621815b849d89602de23/svg/linkwarden.svg), distributed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://github.com/selfhst/icons/blob/b2378abb1a0c64149bb7621815b849d89602de23/LICENSE). Its complete license and warranty disclaimer are included as `frontend/public/service-icons/LICENSE-selfhst.txt`. No changes were made to this artwork.

Product names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners. These icons identify the corresponding services and do not imply endorsement. Collection licenses do not grant trademark rights.

The runtime distribution includes a copy of these credits in `/service-icons/NOTICE.txt`, alongside both licenses.

To add a service, edit `frontend/src/service-catalog.json` and run `node scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs` from the repository root.
